theme: Sign frequency in context, motif concentration and seal standardization
question: Do top-sign frequencies vary by site size or function beyond object composition; are motif concentration and text differences consistent across contexts; how variable are recorded seal dimensions?
outcome: 5,680 faces form 4,695 physical components. Sign 740 is 1,928/19,946 positions; its object-conditioned site q is 0.5379, while sign 032 has q 0.002 across ten signs. No sign's area association survives the amended grouped law across 17 sites (ten have fewer than 20 readable objects). Known square motifs are 1,246/1,609 unicorn, HHI 0.605434. Unicorn versus rare clean texts average 4.794505 versus 4.019355 positions, q 0.0012; sign-distribution divergence fails exact-length conditioning, exploratory q 0.20525. Complete square-seal size n=1,027, CV 0.288599; adjusted length/area slope 1.158998 positions per doubling, q 0.0002. All five analytical outputs and the supplement reproduce; 149 checks pass, zero fail, with 108 reference tails recomputed.
challenge: Published area anchors differ in extent and date; open bounds lack maxima; functional contrasts are represented by one port, craft and rural site each. Sparse site precision affects area references, text length affects motif inventories, and catalogue rounding/range dimensions affect size interpretation. Full style/size precedents and the requested Rao motif item remain unverified.
remedy: Preserved a pre-outcome protocol and source table; grouped complete object payloads inside type/site blocks; corrected across specified outcomes; retained both original and dated exploratory reference laws; excluded zero/range scalar dimensions with a local audit; saved witnesses and failures locally; wrote source notes and deterministic verification without changing shared files.
retry_when: Contemporaneous occupied-site areas and excavation denominators are available; small sites and minority motifs have substantially larger independent samples; original calibrated seal dimensions and workshop/carving-style assignments can test predefined size classes; unread direct precedents and the Rao motif item have been obtained.
